title: Foundry Leadership Signal + Priority Handoff
summary: Quarterly leadership huddle to align on near-term priorities: reliability investments, Dedicated capacity roadmap, Private deployment milestones, hiring posture, and budget tradeoffs. Decided to prioritize SLA workstreams, postpone three low-impact feature bets, and run a Dedicated capacity pilot with two enterprise customers. Action items assigned for a cross-functional SLO playbook and a customer-facing security update deck.
